page.overview:
Who is Goto?

Goto is a young man of average height, and a rather fit build, as he is able to carry Tanjiro in a fireman hold when ordered to bring him to the Corps Headquarters. Most of his features are blocked by the head covering and the mask all members of the Kakushi adorn, but it is shown he possesses wide, half-moon shaped eyes with brown irises and no pupils. His short hair peeking out from the sides of his head covering are black in color.

Goto's primary personality trait is his sardonic attitude. He has a habit of dryly commenting on the eccentricities of members in the Demon Slayer Corps, whether it be an inward comment in his head, or a blunt and sarcastic statement. Targets of his scorn include the loud, energetic, and aggressive personalties of Zenitsu Agatsuma, Inosuke Hashibira, and Hotaru Haganezuka and superhuman abilties such as Tanjiro and Mitsuri Kanroji's appetite, and the short time in which the former was able to recover from his injuries.

Despite his usually calm personality for his line of work, Goto can have a fiery temper. He angrily yelled at Tanjiro for interrupting the meeting of the Hashira just to get back at one of them, demanding repeatedly for an apology. He also chastised Kanao for not informing anyone that Tanjiro had awakened from his coma, in spite of the respect that he usually has for her.

Goto possesses deep respect for Tanjiro, Inosuke, and Zenitsu because of their capability and bravery. In spite of his sarcasm, he still shows a caring personality for most of his appearances. He is shown to be thoughtful when he delivers castella to Tanjiro after he is comatose from his battle in Yoshiwara, and makes small talk with him after his battle in the Swordsmith Village, even inquiring on the well being of his sister.
